caption:
the whole day is about six decisions and I make almost none of them 🤍

#routine #healthylifestyle #wellness

slides.text:
6:40, and my day
is already decided

I read one card

It looked at my night
and picked today for me

Protein first

Before coffee, every day

Forty minutes

Not the two hours
I would have forced

Walk after lunch

The cheapest thing
on the whole list

Same bedtime

This is the part
that decides tomorrow

slides.heading: Six decisions, none of them mine
slides.body: SOMA reads your watch, your sleep and your meals — and hands you the day already made
